name: Ducati Scrambler 800 (2023 on)
intro: The second-generation Scrambler, lighter, with ride-by-wire and a TFT dash.

H: Ducati timing belts are changed by time as well as miles. If you can't prove when they were done, do them before riding.

recallNote: Ducati has issued recalls on some bikes in these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
